body: Independent integration review found normal short-plan fitView leaves the lowest ticket side 165–276 CSS pixels above the viewport floor. The pure motion engine's fixed 120px reach makes those valid layouts unclimbable (300s seeded simulation: zero climbs/support). DM-128 must reconcile rendered viewport scale with motion reach using a continuous jump-to-side and targeted regression; no floating-air climb. Narrow contract extension is part of UI integration, preserving previously accepted trajectory guarantees.
